note: Used by DemoSource (offline demo) AND by tests. Segments = what STT would return. llm = canned LLM response (includes deliberate hallucinations that grounding must reject). expected = engine output after lexicon + grounded llm events. Also use the segment texts as the roleplay lines when recording demo WAVs.

segments.text: Namaste, main CBI Mumbai se Inspector Sharma bol raha hoon.
Aapke Aadhaar se ek parcel gaya hai jisme drugs mile hain.
Aapke naam pe money laundering ka case darj hai, arrest warrant nikla hai.
Abhi verify karna padega, ek ghante mein nahi hua toh team ghar aayegi.
Ye confidential investigation hai, kisi ko mat batana, family ko bhi nahi.
Call mat kaatna aur camera on rakho.
Verification ke liye paise RBI ke safe account mein transfer karo aur OTP batao.

segments.text: Hello, main FedEx courier se bol raha hoon, aapka ek parcel customs ne rok liya hai.
Usme paanch passport aur drugs mile hain, ye illegal hai.
Main call Mumbai Police cyber cell ko transfer kar raha hoon.
Aapko turant ek video call pe statement dena hoga.
Case clear karne ke liye 2 lakh refundable security UPI ID customs.clearance@okaxis pe bhejiye.

drugs mile hain, ye illegal hai
turant ek video call pe statement dena hoga

events.explanation_hi: Paise UPI se maange ja rahe hain

llm.summary_hi: Caller ne parcel mein drugs ka dar dikha ke 2 lakh UPI se maange. Ye courier scam hai.

segments.text: Main TRAI se bol raha hoon, aapka SIM 2 ghante mein band ho jaayega.
Aapke Aadhaar se ek aur number liya gaya hai jo illegal activities mein use hua.
Aapke khilaaf FIR ho sakti hai, isliye abhi police se baat karni hogi.

llm.summary_hi: Caller TRAI ban ke SIM band aur FIR ka dar dikha raha hai. Abhi paise nahi maange, lekin ye scam ki shuruaat lagti hai.

segments.text: Namaste, main aapke bank ke customer care se bol raha hoon, aapka card block karne ki request aayi thi.
Request confirm ho gayi hai, naya card 7 din mein aapke ghar aa jaayega.
Yaad rakhiye, bank kabhi OTP ya PIN nahi maangta, kisi ke saath OTP share mat kijiye.

llm.summary_hi: Ye ek normal bank call lagti hai. Kisi ne OTP ya paise nahi maange.

segments.text: Namaste, main local police station se constable Verma bol raha hoon, aapke passport verification ke liye call kiya hai.
Kal subah gyarah baje apne original documents leke thane aa jaana.
Agar kal nahi aa sakte toh parson aa jaana, koi dikkat nahi.

events.quote: main local police station se constable Verma bol raha hoon

llm.summary_hi: Ye passport verification ki normal call lagti hai. Koi dhamki ya paise ki maang nahi hai.

segments.text: Papa main Rohan bol raha hoon, mera phone kharab ho gaya, ye dost ka number hai.
Hospital mein hoon, abhi turant pachaas hazaar chahiye.
Is number pe UPI kar do, main shaam ko sab bata dunga.

events.quote: Is number pe UPI kar do

llm.summary_hi: Naye number se beta ban ke turant paise maange gaye. Pehle Rohan ko unke purane number pe call karke confirm karein.
